hero.title: Clarity for what you eat and use, every day.
hero.subtitle: Auraly helps you understand ingredients in your food, skincare, and personal care products with AI-powered analysis in any language.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get ingredient insights in three simple steps

step1.title: Scan or Upload
step1.description: Take a photo of any product label or upload an existing image

step2.title: AI Analysis
step2.description: Our AI extracts and analyzes every ingredient for potential health risks

step3.title: Get Insights
step3.description: Understand what's safe and what to watch out for in plain language

multilang.title: Multi-Language Support
multilang.description: Scan labels in any language. We'll automatically detect and translate for accurate analysis.

risk.title: Risk Assessment
risk.description: Clear color-coded risk levels help you quickly identify safe and potentially harmful ingredients.

smart.title: Smart Analysis
smart.description: Context-aware analysis tailored to product type — food, skincare, oral care, or cosmetics.

privacy.title: Your Privacy Matters
privacy.description: Your data stays private — images aren't stored on our servers. Analysis happens in real-time and results are only saved in your browser.
